fun_fact: Why does Assam flood almost every year? The reasons are both geographical and man-made. Assam sits in a valley, so when it pours in the neighbouring hill states, all that water drains into Assam's rivers and they spill over. Human activity — mining and the encroachment of floodplains — has made it worse, and climate change, with its more intense, erratic rain, has only added to the misery.
author: Sailee
